latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Self-Improvement skill for OpenClaw and other coding agents.

- Captures errors, user corrections, feature requests, and key learnings in markdown log files: `.learnings/ERRORS.md`, `LEARNINGS.md`, and `FEATURE_REQUESTS.md`
- Provides detailed templates and instructions for logging and promoting learnings to project memory
- Includes OpenClaw integration for workspace-wide sharing and session hooks
- Supplies reference materials, logging formats, and example workflows for consistent self-improvement tracking
- Designed for flexible use with OpenClaw, Claude, Copilot, and manual setups
